Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:Traveling Water 
 Screen System
 U-33300
 Magrini Galileo - Italy
Introduction

This document outlines the 
 equipment inspection list I2, which must be performed every six months as indicated 
by M6 in the above titled block

The Traveling water screen system is used for cleaning of the Nile River water 
utilized for the operation of the combined cycle power station from plastics, 
wood .... etc

The first draft initiated by 
eng. Mohamed Abd El Azeem, tested by eng. Mohamed Fawzy Agwa at 06 July 2004, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Abouda Elbanna, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed El Sarrag, 
approved by eng Moneer Mahmoud Al Wakeel; Damietta power station head sector, and certified by eng. Aly Al Lethy: 
EDEPCo inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance staff carry the suitable 
safety ID category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety helmets, shoes, ear plug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the screen mechanically and electrically.

Maintenance tool set.
Grease (multi purpose grease).
Wires to raise up the screen cover.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Grease the 
 motor roller bearing.

Grease the 
 sliding roller bearings.

Grease the 
 sliding roller pins.
Check any wear of the washing nozzles

Check the bolts fixation to avoid the 
 vibration
